description: Defines the abstract class gl::RenderbufferImpl for rendering buffer implementations in ANGLE, including method declarations and inline implementations.

classes.name: RenderbufferImpl
classes.description: Abstract class for renderbuffer implementations, providing interface for storage setup and image retrieval.

methods.name: getMemorySize
methods.description: Returns the memory size of the renderbuffer; default implementation returns 0.

methods.name: getColorReadFormat
methods.description: Returns the color read format; default implementation calls UNREACHABLE.

methods.name: getColorReadType
methods.description: Returns the color read type; default implementation calls UNREACHABLE.

methods.name: getRenderbufferImage
methods.description: Retrieves the image data from the renderbuffer; default implementation calls UNREACHABLE.
